title: Executive at Systems Integrator Expects Teradata-Related Business to Grow 6%–8% in 2026 and 8%–12% in 2027
expert: CIO and CISO at a systems integrator (current; ~12 Teradata customers in financial services, healthcare, retail)
verdict: Across ~12 Teradata customers, Q4 deal closures are running ~5%–7% above plan and renewals 2%–5% ahead of forecast, with managed-cloud ACV up 15%–20%, while on-prem maintenance keeps shrinking 5%–8%.

Cloud ARR: 🟢 Managed-cloud average ACV up 15%–20% y/y on larger capacity commitments; VantageCloud subscription +15%–20% in Q4 (estimate); first read, no earlier expert call or stored row. [11 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269149&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse25359&hl=fse25359,fse25464,fse25942&page=2)

🟡 35%–40% of pipeline is migration that often replaces on-prem commitments rather than adding new spend; first read. [11 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269149&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse25359&hl=fse25359,fse25464,fse25942&page=2)
Demand / pipeline: 🟢 Q4 deal closures 5%–7% above plan; forward 3-to-6-month pipeline 8%–10% above prior expectations, total value +10%–15% in 90 days; first read. [1 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269149&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse23975&hl=fse23975,fse24154&page=2)

🔴 Large deals take 20%–30% longer than two years ago; renewals now 4 or 5, sometimes 6 months vs 2 or 3; first read. [4 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269149&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse15557&hl=fse15557,fse15693,fse15748,fse15817&page=2)
Pricing & competition: 🟢 Subscription pricing +4%–6% y/y, maintenance renewals +3%–5%; first read on Teradata pricing. [6 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269149&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse46848&hl=fse46848,fse47097,fse47223&page=2)

🔴 ~15% of workload base displaced over the prior couple of years; Snowflake wins warehouse modernization, Databricks new AI workloads; first read. [8 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-269149&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse11495&hl=fse11495&page=2)

new_datapoints.text: Systems integrator (~12 Teradata customers): Q4 2026 deal closures 5%–7% above plan; renewals 2%–5% ahead of forecast
Teradata managed-cloud average ACV up 15%–20% y/y
Teradata subscription pricing +4%–6% y/y; maintenance renewals +3%–5%
Teradata large deals take 20%–30% longer to close than two years ago; renewals 4–6 months vs 2–3
About 15% of Teradata workload base displaced over prior couple of years (expert's accounts)
Teradata pipeline: 35%–40% migration, 20%–30% renewals, 20%–25% expansion, 10%–15% new; forward pipeline 8%–10% above prior expectations
Expert sees Teradata-related growth 7%–10% in Q4 2026 (VantageCloud +15%–20%, on-prem maintenance -5%–8%), 6%–8% CY2026, 8%–12% CY2027
SI's Teradata services opportunity up at least 15%–20% as Teradata shrinks its services footprint
